attBesluta.text: Für mein Motorrad leider zu klein topp Abwicklung aber bezüglich retur senden
Just as described, smaller size is perfect for day trips on dual purpose KLX300. They are not sealed very well and can let in dust. Suggest wrapping your things in plastic bags good product
Worked exactly as instructed. Holds everything I need it to hold
Top rapport qualité prix, fidèles à la description, faciles à mettre en place, super contente de mon achat

The bags arrived as described. Unfortunately, they do not work for our Ebikes and we will be ordering a different style. We requested a refund and the process was quickly resolved. We've ordered many items from Vevor and they do not disappoint.
Because our bike is quite small these small and simple design work great for packing a few items on the bike...

Fantastic, absolutely 100%. In my kitchen it would be nice if the car was a bit higher, so my question to VEVOR: Is it possible to order extension legs in the future to make the cart at counter height? As a 66-year-old woman, in a semi-illuminated room, yet assembled effortlessly. The car is right in front of my washing machine and it is no problem to drive it a bit to open the washing machine. It rolls easily
Excellent quality great value great Seller could not be more happy thanks
Le chariot est très pratique solide ne rouille pas car je l'améne à la salle de bain. Très pratique pour mes soins.
Recently bought the trolley the only concern is that some of the top edges are very sharp, so some plastic covering would help protect users from cutting their hands.
I have had this kit for a few months now. So far it has had all of the lockouts I’ve needed for various breaker styles and panels.
De kwaliteit voor sommige plastic kapjes is erg laag, maar over het algemeen is het zeer goede prijs/kwaliteit verhouding.

I use mine for hosting trivia and Bingo. It hold my laptop and other tools great! Super sturdy and well made. The top adjust length pretty easy and you can adjust the height of the top by adjusting the legs. It is very stable and not rocky or shaky at all. Has worked great for my use.
Excellent studio and stage stand for outboard gear.
Good quality product. Price-quality. I recommend it.

Table was easy to put together and as per specs, was wide/deep enough to hold my controllers and gear. The table also comes up to a good height without having to hunch over the controllers. While it's not a one-piece, I'd caution against placing very heavy items or leaning on it, but for light interaction, it did just fine on stage. Would recommend.
It fits my laptop, Pioneer ‹REDIGERAT› and 2 bookshelf speakers with room to spare for my mouse and also headphones when I'm not wearing them.
This stand is excellent. The only thing is, I wish it came with a carrying bag

I used it for drum machines, guitar pedals, and for if I need a medium sized table. Excellent quality, Easy to setup within 1 minutes. Stores away in 1 minute. Excellent Product from VEVO!!!! VERY INNOVATIVE COMPANY!!
Cart was better than expected. Well build and very sturdy. Easy to put together. Going to order another one when back in stock. - GM

I love this dolly it is so light but so versatile and reliable. I did not expect this to perform well when we install our washer and dryer with pedestal installed on our laundry room. It made our life so easy with this dolly. It has low profile and the wheels rotating which helps to maneuver heavy objects on tight space. One good thing about this you can put them together with different orientation.

Bought 2 sets of 2 to help move boxes of merchandise and bulky equipment for volunteer work. Super light, super easy and clicks to lock in to enable larger moves with better weight distribution. Super slim, with strong wheels so that you don't have to lift onto the dolly. Best part is that I can put them in a backpack and take them wherever needed. Would recommend highly. Would buy again. Love them.

It’s a good product, everything vevor makes is great, this dolly can be used as a single or double but I wish it had a more secure locking mechanism when being used together, otherwise it comes apart quite easily.
